summary: Extracts a string from the indexed member slot this[7*a2 + 2609] (falling back to byte_5EA438 when null), copies it into the output buffer a3 with a length limit of a4-1, and null-terminates. Then asks ConditionalDispatch_81f0 for the game filter string (aGameFilter); if one exists and it plus the copied text plus 1 fits within a4, appends word_5C32D8 (the extension marker) followed by the game filter string to the buffer. Returns non-null when the append was performed.

operations.description: Compute the source string v4 as the value of the indexed member slot this[7*a2 + 2609].
If the indexed slot is null, use byte_5EA438 as the fallback source string.
Copy the source string into the output buffer a3 with a length limit of a4-1 via sub_587DD0.
Null-terminate the copied string by setting a3[a4-1] to 0.
Call ConditionalDispatch_81f0 with the aGameFilter string to obtain the game filter value.
If a game filter result exists and strlen(filter) + 1 + strlen(a3) is less than a4, append word_5C32D8 followed by the game filter string to the output buffer.
Return the game filter result pointer, which is null when the append was skipped.

unresolved: Exact meaning of the indexed member stride (7 dwords per entry, slot base 2609) and of the string stored there is unknown.
word_5C32D8 is a two-byte marker whose text value is unconfirmed; the .HOT extension reading is DERIVED only.
dword_8AD3B4 appears in the packet global list but is not referenced by this function's raw source; its role here is unclear.
